_comment: Pipeline-level defaults. `defaults.dua_*` fill any row whose dua_arabic is blank; a row with its own verified dua_arabic overrides this. All Arabic here is operator-verified Unicode.

defaults.dua_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
defaults.dua_translation: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
defaults.bismillah_translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
